messages.content: look i have some pages design prototypes right? in html?

Yes. They live in two places:

**`prototypes/`** — the tracked prototype system (registered + versioned + "settled" status, shown on the app's Protos page via `/api/protos`). Three of them, all currently `settled`:

- `prototypes/casino-settings/casino-settings.html` — module `casino_settings`. **This is your active one** — your last commits (`prototype chunk casino-settings c1 …`) are chunking it into Buildprint steps. Has `build-plan.json` + 4 chunk prompts in `prototypes/casino-settings/chunks/`.
- `prototypes/buttons/buttons.html` — module `user_management` (registered from `crs-brain/data/docs/buttons.html`).
- `prototypes/studio-sample/studio-sample.html` — module `user_management` (scaffolded from the cards template).

**`demos/`** — raw standalone HTML mockups, not tracked as protos:

- `demos/casino_property_settings.html` (the source the casino-settings proto was registered from) + a `(2)` variant
- `demos/CRS_BreakList.html`, `demos/CRS_Canvas.html`, `demos/CRS_Coming_Soon.html`

Plus the design reference `design/CRS_UI_Kit.html`.

What do you want to do with them — keep working the casino-settings chunks, register a demo as a new proto, or something else?

messages.content: i want you to create a page with all modules i have now with sidebar menu to select prototype

Good — `serveStatic` handles any GET path against `PUBLIC_DIR` generically (line 4882), so `/app-preview.html` is served automatically, same as `protos.html`. No route registration needed.

The page is ready at **`crs-brain/public/app-preview.html`**. Open it via the app's home screen tile **"App Preview"** (Tools section) or directly at `http://localhost:4317/app-preview.html`.

What it does:
- Left sidebar lists all 46 modules grouped into the real 7 sections, in build-priority order, pulled live from `/api/modules`.
- A green dot marks modules that have a registered prototype (`casino_settings`, `user_management`); a gray dot marks the other 44 (roadmap, no prototype yet).
- Click a module → its prototype loads in an iframe via `/api/raw`, with a status chip (draft/settled/built). `user_management` has two prototypes (`buttons`, `studio-sample`), so it shows tabs to switch between them.
- No-prototype modules show a "Coming soon" empty state with a link straight to the Prototypes page to register one.

I couldn't run `curl` in this session to hit it live (permission blocked), but the server is already running and serves any file under `crs-brain/public/` generically — same mechanism `protos.html` uses — so it'll load. Open it in your browser and let me know if anything looks off.
